items.text: Bears planning to start QB Caleb Williams vs Falcons after full week of practice with no setbacks from torn hamstring; was listed questionable.
items.why: Full participant all week, took starter reps, ready to roll per sources.
items.implication: QB1 return in favorable spot vs ATL; upgrade pass catchers.

items.text: Eagles officially placed QB Jalen Hurts on injured reserve due to a blood clot after consultations with doctors; out for the foreseeable future. Tanner McKee will start.
items.why: Blood clot in calf/leg; extensive medical consults led to IR decision Saturday.
items.implication: Extended absence likely multi-week or longer; McKee starts vs CAR with thin RB room.
items.opportunity: Pass-catcher volume (Smith, Goedert, Wicks) remains but overall offense downgraded; low team total.

items.text: Patriots officially activated WR A.J. Brown to 53-man roster from IR; expected to play Sunday vs Jets after high-ankle sprain.
items.why: Activated after practice week; eligible and cleared to return.
items.implication: Instant WR2/WR1 upside if full go; start if active.
items.opportunity: High target share likely in NE offense vs NYJ.

items.text: Saquon Barkley ruled OUT for Week 6 (hamstring) along with Will Shipley; Eagles RB room thin with 4th-string Dameon Pierce likely lead.
items.why: Hamstring; did not practice, officially out per ETR Sunday list and reports.
items.implication: Zero production; handcuff/backup scramble in PHI.
items.opportunity: Pierce or other RBs see expanded carries/goal-line; pass game more relevant.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren Friday Q add (groin). Caleb/Metcalf/Olave/Dowdle more probable. PIT thin at WR (Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek out) so heavy 2-WR Metcalf + Bernard. PHI McKee has top-4 pass-catchers healthy (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon) but 4th-string RB Pierce.
items.why: Practice/report parsing; Friday additions and probable tags; depth chart notes.
items.implication: Monitor Brown/Henderson closely; Metcalf volume spike; PHI pass game viable.
items.opportunity: PIT 2-WR sets boost Metcalf; PHI healthy WRs/TE despite RB thinness.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT for Week 6 (ankle); Ravens without him again.
items.why: Ankle injury; listed OUT on comprehensive ETR report.
items.implication: Backup QB start; Flowers/Andrews/Henry usage shifts possible.
items.opportunity: Check Huntley or backup for volume; Henry still goal-line.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad) for Week 6 along with AD Mitchell.
items.why: Quad; confirmed OUT on ETR Sunday injuries.
items.implication: Jets RB committee or backup elevated.

items.opportunity: Xavier Worthy and Kelce usage up.

items.text: DeVonta Smith IN / cleared, no designation after hamstring; will play with McKee.
items.why: Removed from report / full practice Friday; ETR IN.
items.implication: WR2/3 with McKee; healthy top pass-catchers.

items.text: Loves Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5) for elite recent usage and soft run defense matchup.
items.why: Volume elite lately; ARI leaks vs run.

items.text: Loves Drake London vs CHI (WR6) on bankable usage vs soft pass D.
items.why: Usage you can bank on; CHI defense buffet for pass catchers.

items.text: Hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28) due to tough matchup and QB issues.
items.why: Ugly SEA matchup + shaky QB situation.

items.text: Ravens officially activated WR Ja’Kobi Lane from IR; expected to play Sunday vs Browns.
items.why: Activated from IR, expected to play.
items.implication: Depth WR addition with Lamar out.
